signedInDevicesExplanation: Only browser sign-ins to this account center are listed here (they let the LiteSync and Nexus web apps open without a password). Connected Obsidian devices and browser extensions are not listed: manage Obsidian in LiteSync (账号与设备) and extensions in Nexus (设置 › 账号与同步). To disconnect everything at once, use 退出所有产品与设备 (sign out of all products and devices) in either product.
signOutAllDevicesWarning: This ends your account-center sign-ins in every browser, including this one, and signs you out of the LiteSync and Nexus web apps. Connected Obsidian devices and browser extensions are not affected; to disconnect them, use 退出所有产品与设备 in LiteSync or Nexus.
